explanation: Fires only at the GO step, when the agent chooses a2 after the previous trial was a2 with a common transition to S2 that was rewarded, and only late in the episode: about 3 near trial 86, rising to 4-7 around trials 90-94 and 8-10 from trial 95 on (usually 9-10 when the streak of rewarded a2 trials goes back two or more trials). It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, 0 before about trial 85, and 0 at GO when the previous trial was unrewarded, was rare, or was a1.
